main_text.l: לַחַץ m. Oppresio, 1.Reg.22.27. Aff. לַחֲצֵנוּ Oppresio-nem nostram, Deut.26.7.

לָחַשׁ Mussitavit: Incantavit, quod mussitanda fieri solet: Particip. Plural. לְקוֹל מְלַחֲשִׁים Voci mussitantium vel incantantium, Psalm.58.6. Hithp. Participium, מִתְלַחֲשִׁים Mussitantes inter se, submissè loquentes, 2.Samuel.12.19. Futurum, יִתְלַחֲשׁוּ Mussitant, Psalm.41.8.
לַחַשׁ m. Mussitatio, Submissa Oratio, Jesa.26.16. Et generaliter, Locutio, Elocutio, Pronunciatio, Jes.3.3. Incantatio, Jer.8.17. Eccles.10.11.
לְחָשִׁים m.p. Amuleta, Jesa.3.20. Ab. Efra [?] scribit, esse characteres auro vel argento scriptas, formâ vel modo incantationis: Quidam, Inaures.
לטא לְטָאָה f. Stellio, reptile immundum, Levit.11. v.30. R.Salomon Lacertam interpretatur.

לטש Acuit, Polivit: Metaphoricè, Erudivit: Particip. לוֹטֵשׁ Acuentem, Acutè erudien-tem, Gen.4.22. Infinit. לִלְטוֹשׁ Ad poliendum, 1.Sam.13. v.20. Futur. יִלְטוֹשׁ Acuit, Vibrat, Job.16.9. יִלְטוֹשׁ Acuet, Psalm.7.13. Pyh. Partic. כְּתַעַר מְלֻטָּשׁ Similis novacule acuta, Psal.52.4.

לִיל m. Nox: כְּלַיִל Sicut noctem, Jesa.16.3. Constr. לֵיל שָׁמְרִים Nox observationum, Exod.12. v.42, quod tamen etiam absolutum esse videtur citra constructionem, בְּלֵיל In nocte, Noctu, Jes.15.1. Cum ה paragogico, לֵילָה Nox, Gen.14.15. & manet masculinū; ut, בְּלֵילָה הַוּא Nocte ipsa, Gen.19.33. Plural. לֵילוֹת Noctes, 1.Sam.30.12. Chald. דִּי לֵילְיָא Noctis, Dan.2.19. בַּהּ בְּלֵילְיָא In eadem nocte, Dan.5.30.

page.notes: The large Hebrew root letters (לטא, לטש, לִיל) are headword display type and are kept at the start of their entries. Several Hebrew vocalised forms are copied as read from a low-resolution scan; the vowel points in לְחָשִׁים, כְּלַיִל and בַּהּ are the least certain. "Efra" is marked [?] because the initial letter is blurred. Long s is written as plain s throughout, per the transcription rules.
